elevenlabsPrompt:
[exasperated] Twenty percent left and three hours till you're home?

[confident] Here's the fix. Turn on Low Power Mode.

[friendly] Open Settings, then Battery. Switch on Low Power Mode. Or tap the battery in Control Center.

[delighted] The icon turns yellow, and those last few percent stretch a lot further.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
